messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “sweet spot” for visiting Hawaii is typically **late spring through early fall**—specifically **April, May, September, October, and November**.  

| Month | Why it’s great |
|-------|----------------|
| **April / May** | Warm, sunny weather (average highs 78–84 °F / 26–29 °C) but before the peak summer crowds. |
| **September / October** | Still warm (highs 80–85 °F / 27–29 °C), but the summer rush has eased and rates often drop. |
| **November** | Mild temperatures (highs 75–80 °F / 24–27 °C), fewer tourists, and the start of the winter season brings a pleasant, breezy vibe. |

These months combine comfortable temperatures, lower crowds, and better deals on accommodations and flights. If you’re looking for the absolute best balance of weather and value, aim for **late April to early May or late September to early October**.
